audit.why: Pantheon 52.38% for Trundle over 189 games. Early lane genuinely belongs to Pantheon (Shield Vault 13s at rank 1 plus Comet Spear burst before Frozen Domain exists); the flip is level 6 and the side lane, which the prose already claims.
audit.corrected: Kept early stages Pantheon-favoured, corrected the two item stages to Trundle so the chart stops contradicting a 52.38% win rate and its own late-game text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gave Pantheon both item stages while the late-game prose says Trundle splitpushes freely and out-duels him; Grand Starfall's cooldown was never used.
audit.why: Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s — a roam that long is a free wave crash for Trundle, and it is the concrete spike marker the text lacked.
audit.corrected: First item and 2+ items flipped to Trundle in both layers; Grand Starfall's 180s rank-1 cooldown written into mid as a shove trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text called Aegis Assault his PASSIVE and invented 'Comet of Legend passive shield'. Pantheon's passive is Mortal Will; Aegis Assault is his E (22/21/20/19/18s) and it blocks damage from the front while channelling. The Shield Vault auto-attack reset was never mentioned.
audit.why: The whole early-lane plan depends on knowing the block is a 22-second E on a channel you can walk away from, not a permanent passive, and that his combo opens with an auto reset.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault named as E with its cooldown, Mortal Will named as the passive, 'Comet of Legend' removed, and Shield Vault's auto-reset wind-up flagged as the step-back cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere (flagged in the packet defects).
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 and Chomp is a flat 3.5s, so a spent Shield Vault buys roughly three bites. That is the whole early-lane punish window.
audit.corrected: Added the 13s-vs-3.5s window to early and breakdown.cooldowns, plus 'Subjugate first, not last' keyed to its 4-second doubling.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Farm with Q at range' — Chomp is 300 range on a melee champion, there is no ranged farming option.
audit.why: Advice that implies safe ranged CS will get players killed stepping up into Comet Spear.
audit.corrected: Replaced with last-hitting at 300 range and King's Tribute sustain off dying minions.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'His R Grand Starfall requires a channel — Pillar of Ice disrupts his setup' asserts a displacement interrupt that Riot's text does not support.
audit.why: Pillar of Ice is described only as impassable terrain plus a slow; the shove-out displacement and whether it interrupts Grand Starfall's wind-up are not in the data available here.
audit.corrected: Claim removed and replaced with the verifiable 180s cooldown consequence. Logged as unverified rather than restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two places described Chomp as an attack-SPEED steal or debuff.
audit.why: Riot's Chomp text says it saps Attack Damage. The confusion changes how a player reads the trade and what he itemises.
audit.corrected: Both rewritten as an attack-damage sap, with Chomp's 3.5s cooldown attached so the cadence is concrete.

edits.before: Pantheon's empowered W stun is available immediately and his passive Aegis Assault blocks your Chomp auto — you cannot win the level-1 trade.
edits.after: Aegis Assault is his E, not his passive — at level 1 he has a single ability up, so Chomp's flat damage and AD sap take the auto exchange.

edits.before: His Q spear poke plus W stun combo comes online fully at level 2 before you have Frozen Domain to disengage — he owns this window.
edits.after: At 2 he pairs Comet Spear with Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) — one dash-stun into spear chunks you before Frozen Domain exists. Give ground.

edits.before: With all three of his basic abilities up he can stun, spear, and out-burst you before your W ice field provides meaningful healing — respect his level 3.
edits.after: At 3 Aegis Assault (22s) joins the stun and spear: he takes no damage from the front while it channels, so your Chomps land on a wall. Walk out of it.

edits.before: Pantheon's empowered W point-click stun into Q spear combo deletes your HP before Frozen Domain is even online — his passive blocks your Chomp autos freely.
edits.after: Shield Vault (13s) is a targeted dash-stun that also resets his auto, then Comet Spear lands the burst — and Aegis Assault (E), not his passive, is what eats your Chomps.

edits.before: Use the Comet of Legend passive shield to block Chomp autos and deny Trundle the attack damage steal
edits.after: Pop Aegis Assault (E, 22s) as Chomp lands so the frontal block soaks the bite and denies the AD steal

edits.before: Pantheon runs you over levels 1 through 3. His empowered W is point-click — it stuns you in place while his Q spear follows for massive burst, and his passive Aegis Assault blocks your Chomp autos so you never even get the attack damage steal rolling. Do not look for extended trades here. Farm with Q at range, accept the poke, and use your passive King's Tribute healing off minion deaths to stay relevant. If he wastes the W stun on a minion or misses his Q, that is your window to retaliate briefly, but do not commit your E Pillar yet — save it for a genuine disengage rather than an all-in you will lose.
edits.after: Pantheon runs you over levels 1 through 3. Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) is targeted — it dashes to you, stuns, and resets his auto, then Comet Spear lands the burst. Aegis Assault is his E, not his passive: while it channels he takes no damage from the front, so your Chomps land on a wall. Do not look for extended trades here. Last-hit at Chomp's 300 range, accept the poke, and let King's Tribute heal you off dying minions. If he spends Shield Vault on a minion you get roughly three Chomps (3.5s each) before it returns — bite, then walk. Hold Pillar of Ice for his step-up, not for an all-in you lose.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are still his territory but his all-in damage starts leveling off — you are not dying to a single rotation anymore if you kept your HP up. Begin placing Frozen Domain proactively when he steps up to poke, so the movement speed is already running when he commits. At level 6 the lane flips: hit Subjugate the moment he goes for a trade, strip half his armor and MR onto yourself, drop Frozen Domain under both of you, and Chomp repeatedly while his own resistances melt. His R Grand Starfall requires a channel — Pillar of Ice disrupts his setup if he tries to use it in lane or chase a roam. This is your strongest window.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are still his territory but his all-in damage levels off — one rotation stops killing you outright if you kept your HP up. Place Frozen Domain before he steps up to poke, so the move speed is already running when he commits. At level 6 the lane flips: Subjugate the moment he starts the trade, because the armor and MR it steals double over the following 4 seconds — it is an opener, not a finisher. Then Chomp inside your domain while his resists sit on you. Grand Starfall is a 180-second ultimate at rank 1, so the moment he leaves to use it, shove and take the free crash. This is your strongest window.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — His all-in start. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Pantheon Shield Vault: Leaps to a target, stuns, and strikes — his all-in start. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Shield Vault (W): 13/12/11/10/9s. His engage, and it resets his auto — the wind-up is the tell, not the cast. Spent, it buys ~3 Chomps. - Aegis Assault (E): 22/21/20/19/18s. Frontal block on a channel — step around it, then bite.

edits.before: W down at your feet turns short trades your way: move speed, attack speed, and healing on your own terrain. Trade only inside the zone.
edits.after: Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) into Comet Spear is a real kill threat now and Frozen Domain is still a level away. Hold the wave near you and farm.

edits.before: Pillar closes the kit — use it behind Pantheon to deny disengage, or between you and Shield Vault (Stun) to break his pattern.
edits.after: Aegis Assault (22s) joins the kit: he takes no frontal damage while it channels. Bite after it ends, not into it — Pillar slows him.

edits.before: Stay on top of him inside Frozen Domain where Chomp's attack speed debuff compounds his falling-off damage output
edits.after: Stay on top of him inside Frozen Domain, where Chomp saps his attack damage every 3.5s and blunts his frontloaded burst

edits.before: Past first item Iceborn Gauntlet, Pantheon's damage is heavily frontloaded and his teamfight utility shrinks to his R setup. Your Subjugate keeps eating his resistances in every extended skirmish, and Frozen Domain plus Chomp's attack speed steal mean he cannot reliably run away once engaged. Splitpush against him freely — he has no sustained dueling power at this stage and your W ice field makes 1v1 chases hopeless for him. In teamfights, use Subjugate on the tankiest enemy, not necessarily Pantheon, to maximize the resistance drain, and let your team follow up inside the Frozen Domain zone.
edits.after: Past first item Iceborn Gauntlet, Pantheon's damage is heavily frontloaded and his teamfight utility shrinks to his R setup. Your Subjugate keeps eating his resistances in every extended skirmish, and Frozen Domain plus Chomp's AD sap and slow mean he cannot reliably run away once engaged. Splitpush against him freely — he has no sustained dueling power at this stage and your W ice field makes 1v1 chases hopeless for him. In teamfights, use Subjugate on the tankiest enemy, not necessarily Pantheon, to maximize the resistance drain, and let your team follow up inside the Frozen Domain zone.

notes: Removed an unverified claim that Pillar of Ice interrupts Grand Starfall — Riot's Pillar text mentions only impassable terrain and a slow, so the displacement-interrupt is unconfirmed here. Also: the full layer names Trinity Force as the first-item spike while the content layer names Iceborn Gauntlet; both layers left as found, but they should be reconciled by whoever owns Trundle's build data. Subjugate steals 'a percent' of resists (doubled over 4s) — the old text's 'half his armor and MR' was an overstatement and was cut.
